quotes: Creates the project lock file on first use and holds an operating system lock (A6 rule 4).
`state_unavailable` when the lock cannot be taken (A6 rule 5).
Writes only the project lock file and the folders below the state folder that lead to it, on first use (A6 rule 4).

judgement.divergence: One implementation treats every failure while preparing, opening, or locking the lock file as `state_unavailable`, while another retries selected operating-system failures or lets preparation failures escape; module:photo_delivery and its API caller observe a refusal, a delay, or an unclassified failure.
